summary.text: Yvonne Hayes Hinson, a Democrat, represents District 21 in the Florida House of Representatives, first elected in 2020, according to the House's official biography.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists Hinson as an educator from Gainesville, born in Gainesville, and as a Gainesville city commissioner from 2012 to 2015.
Hinson holds a B.A. (1971) and an M.A. (1972) in education from the University of Florida.
